steps.title: Prepare LB medium
steps.instruction: Combine 10 g tryptone (OXOID, cat #: LP0042), 10 g NaCl (HUSHI, cat #: 10019318), 5 g yeast extract (OXOID, cat #: LP0021) and add dH₂O to a final volume of 1 L; autoclave to sterilize.

steps.title: Make infiltration buffer stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mM MES stock by dissolving 4.88 g MES (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat #: M8250) in 50 mL dH₂O and store at 4 °C; prepare 20 mM Na₃PO₄ stock by dissolving 0.17 g Na₃PO₄ (HUSHI, cat #: 20040928) in 50 mL dH₂O and store at 4 °C; prepare 1 M acetosyringone stock by dissolving 0.196 g acetosyringone (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat #: D134406) in 1 mL DMSO (MACKLIN, cat #: C13178602), aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare infiltration buffer
steps.instruction: To 50 mL dH₂O add 250 mg D‑glucose (HUSHI, cat #: 10010518), 5 mL MES stock, 5 mL Na₃PO₄ stock and 5 µL acetosyringone stock; mix to a final volume of 50 mL. Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Make enzymatic solution stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.8 M mannitol stock (7.29 g mannitol, Solarbio, cat #: M8141, in 50 mL dH₂O); 2 M KCl stock (7.455 g KCl, Rhawn, cat #: R051965, in 50 mL dH₂O); 0.2 M MES stock (1.952 g MES, Sigma‑Aldrich, cat #: M8250, in 50 mL dH₂O, adjust to pH 5.7) and store at 4 °C; prepare 1 M CaCl₂ stock (1.11 g CaCl₂, MACKLIN, cat #: C832203, in 10 mL dH₂O) and 10 % BSA stock (0.1 g BSA, MACKLIN, cat #: B928042, in 1 mL dH₂O). Store all stocks at 4 °C.

steps.title: Assemble enzymatic solution
steps.instruction: In a tube combine 0.15 g cellulase R10 (Yakult, cat #: 220908-02), 0.04 g macerozyme R1, 5 mL 0.8 M mannitol stock, 100 µL 2 M KCl stock, and 1 mL 0.2 M MES stock; heat at 55 °C (maximum) for 10 min, cool to room temperature, add 100 µL 1 M CaCl₂ stock, 100 µL 10 % BSA stock and dH₂O to a final volume of 10 mL; sterilize by filtration through a 0.45 µm membrane. Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare antibiotic solution
steps.instruction: Add rifampicin to 50 mg L⁻¹ (Genview, cat #: AR280-1G) and kanamycin to 50 mg L⁻¹ (Genview, cat #: AK177-10G) in LB medium for Agrobacterium selection.

steps.title: Harvest and surface‑sterilize fruit
steps.instruction: Collect ‘Huapi’ or ‘Rongan’ kumquats 150–210 days after flowering, immerse in 2 % sodium hypochlorite (MACKLIN, cat #: S935360) for 2 min, rinse thoroughly with water, and drain on bibulous paper.

steps.title: Grow Agrobacterium culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate GV3101 (Shanghai Weidi Biotechnology, cat #: AC1001) carrying GFP‑Lifeact and P19 into liquid LB containing 50 mg L⁻¹ Rif and 50 mg L⁻¹ Kan; incubate at 28 °C, 220 rpm, 12–16 h until OD₆₀₀ > 1.0.

steps.title: Pellet and resuspend Agrobacterium
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture in a 50 mL Falcon tube at 5,000 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in infiltration buffer; repeat the spin and discard supernatant; adjust the suspension with infiltration buffer to an OD₆₀₀ of ≈ 0.8 (or desired). For co‑expression, mix equal volumes of each construct with an equal amount of P19‑carrying Agrobacterium.

steps.title: Prepare syringe needle
steps.instruction: Trim the needle of a 1 mL syringe (GEMTIER, cat #: 0.45X16 RW LB) to a length of approximately 0.1–0.3 cm.

steps.title: Infiltrate fruit tissue
steps.instruction: Hold the fruit bottom, insert the trimmed needle into the epicarp to a depth of 0.1–0.3 cm, and gently inject 0.2–0.5 mL Agrobacterium suspension; avoid damaging the tissue. The infiltrated area appears as a dark, water‑soaked region (radius 0.8–1.3 cm). Blot excess bacteria with bibulous paper and mark the injection site with a marker pen (STATMARK, cat #: Z648191).

steps.title: Incubate infiltrated fruit
steps.instruction: Place each fruit on the cap of a 15 mL or 50 mL Falcon tube (Corning, cat #: 352070), store at room temperature (25 °C) for ~2 days, then wrap with cling film to prevent dehydration and continue storage at 25 °C.

steps.title: Detect fluorescence at 5 days
steps.instruction: Five days after infiltration, cut the infiltrated region with a sharp blade (size of tissue block not critical), place the tissue blocks on a microscopy slide and examine immediately under a stereomicroscope equipped with a DP70 camera; fluorescent signal near the injection site should be visible.

steps.title: Prepare samples for confocal imaging
steps.instruction: Hand‑slice strongly fluorescent tissue into the thinnest possible pieces and transfer to a slide. (Optional) Incubate pieces in sterilized enzymatic solution for 1–2 h in the dark with shaking at 40 rpm at room temperature to partially digest cell walls; avoid over‑digestion.

steps.title: Mount and image confocal
steps.instruction: Add Vectashield (Vectorlabs, cat #: H-1000) to the sample, gently place a coverslip and press from one side. Perform live‑cell imaging on a Leica SP8 laser‑scanning confocal microscope using a 63× oil‑immersion lens; excite GFP at 488 nm and detect emission at 505–550 nm.
